page.content:
Waterbender of the South and the Gaang's fierce center.

How Katara connects

  • Faction: The Gaang — Katara is a core member of the Gaang.
  • Faction: Water Tribes — Katara is a waterbender of the Southern Water Tribe.

What is Katara?

Katara is the Southern waterbender who becomes Aang's teacher and the group's moral engine, later a master who heals and fights.

Key threads lead to The Gaang and Water Tribes.
